title: The sort's files (the review-triage skill)
description: The lines the sort's pieces write, one JSON object a line. triage.py sorted checks every line against these and names the file, the line and the field.

readiness.description: ready: the remedy is clear and nothing in it is the owner's to choose. choice: it needs the owner's decision. check: it can't be sorted until a fact is known. not now: proposed as later work or as not planned.

depends_on.description: Optional. The findings that must be fixed before it, or that the same change fixes.

related.description: Optional. The findings that change the same function or turn on the same rule, without one having to come first, and a finding whose ruling by the owner this one waits on: they are batched together where they fit, and asked together where they are choices. In a shared file, two related findings keep their units from running side by side.

size.description: small: one or two files and a test. medium: several files, or a proof that needs a container or a VM. large: a feature, or a change across a module.

proof.description: What proving the fix needs: a test, a container, a VM.

note.description: Optional. Anything the unit's session should know that the issue doesn't say.

ask.description: For a choice: the walk-thru item the owner is asked.

means.description: What choosing it means: what changes, and what it costs.

recommendation.description: The sorter's pick and its reason, most often the finding's remedy.

why.description: For a not now, and for a check that showed no defect: the reason.

sort.description: A line of a sort piece's file, triage/sort-<area>.jsonl, or of triage/decided.jsonl, where the coordinator writes a finding's record anew once the owner has decided it: the record the schedule keeps for a finding, and beside it what the owner will be asked. triage.py also holds: a choice has its ask, a not now its why, nothing else has an ask, and a decided record is no choice.

check.description: A line of the checker's file, triage/check.jsonl: its own readiness for a High or Med finding.

readiness.description: ready: the remedy is clear and nothing in it is the owner's to choose. choice: it needs the owner's decision. check: it can't be sorted until a fact is known. not now: proposed as later work or as not planned.
